direction.camera: Guide attention with fluid ink; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: a single flowing boundary reveals a compact focal subject; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with organic edge; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with expressive form.
direction.lighting: flat paper light; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: pigment in water and cream stock; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around quiet motion; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use fluid ink,organic edge,controlled spread,paper contrast,quiet motion,expressive form as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
